description.short: AI-powered market analysis and portfolio tracking for modern traders.
description.full:
TradeVision AI is a decision-first trading research and coaching app. It helps you decide what deserves research time — with a Today brief, setup radar, regime context, journal coaching, chart replay, and an Academy.

Free includes core decision tools and limited AI. Premium unlocks full radar depth, cloud AI coaching, portfolio intelligence, faster quote updates (polling — not exchange ticks), advanced charts, and data export. Choose monthly or yearly billing; yearly includes a 7-day free trial when available.
